name: external-bash
description: External balanced sample for bash (26 malicious + 26 benign), drawn from public labeled datasets (bash-datasets/CC BY-SA 4.0, Atomic Red Team, TLDR, darkknight25, aelhalili — MIT). Gate semantics: external_malicious cases must be covered (effect present or sound ⊤); external_benign cases must be covered without raising ⊤/conservative. See README.md for provenance and methodology.
